gdd_section: 13.7 / 13.8; NH-C01–08 / NH-RG01–06 / 13.9 SD-v1 / SD-v1.1 feedback 2026-11-04 / SD-v1.2 living collection 2026-11-04

criteria.requirement: Ordinary input completes harvest, full cargo, sale and purchase with consistent feedback.

Both regions, single-serving flowers, unlock requirements and two-way shortcut are usable through ordinary input. Hub/pond/meadow stay distinct; courtyard return lands at its dance gate, sale/growth/departure remain individually reachable, creatures do not chase or damage, and per-trip refresh is checked. Route information is available at destination selection and in optional pause help; stocked jars match the original painted shop. Dance skip/reduced-motion/save transitions remain valid. Active progress/work animation, seeded moving flowers with saved regrowth, Q/right-click material collection and material upgrades, stamina return pressure, focal iris/dance transitions must be checked.

Thirteen upgrade purchases, economy, reserve completion and invalid/duplicate transactions pass rules checks. Material conservation, regrowth, stamina growth and strict v1–v4 to v5 migration are included.
Pause/focus loss clears input; actual shutdown and cold resume preserve current and permanent state without legacy-save interference.
Native 960x600 and 1280x800 presentation is readable, coherent and spatially credible. Dance stage supports, art family, field guide and settings are checked at native scales.
Complete ordinary-input native media and independent review, with no unresolved basic defect and honest actor/evidence boundaries.
Same frozen source/export, direct app and maintained command entry, input, save, exit, cold resume and old-save isolation are tested; old-save hashes correspond to retained before/after bytes.
Measured effort and unknowns, tracking readback, CI/integration state and candidate-only status are recorded accurately.
